Run the complete color owner suite through the admitted test adapter; one unsupported assertion helper is expressed as two exact hue assertions without reducing the obligation.

Retain current-theme access, ordered events and root application. The color-theme-engine supplies CSS generation and the packaged-only theming participant registry; no extension, product-icon or file access enters this browser owner.

Verify schema, local digest, marker, license reference, unique ownership, divergence, and evidence parity without a VS Code checkout.
